subject: general
question: The mean proportional between 0.06 and 6 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ 
**Mean Proportional** (MP) = √(a × b)
 
MP = √(0.06 × 6) = √0.36
 
MP = 0.6
 
**∴ The correct answer is 0.6.**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 
**Given:**
 
First number (a) = 0.06
 
Second number (b) = 6
 
**Formula Used:**
 
If **x** is the **mean proportional** between **a** and **b**, then a : x = x : b
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad45985cf5c2916263954a4f1b6272e80c13dd6d9d2ee6877c21ffdd9ca7160.png] 
**Calculations:**
 
⇒ x² = a × b
 
⇒ x² = 0.06 × 6
 
⇒ x² = 0.36
 
⇒ x = √0.36
 
⇒ x = 0.6
 
**∴ The correct answer is 0.6.**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
 
Third Proportional
 
If a : b = b : c, then **c** is the **third proportional** to a and b, calculated as c = b² / a.
 
Fourth Proportional
 
If a : b = c : d, then **d** is the **fourth proportional** to a, b, and c, calculated as d = (b × c) / a.
 
Duplicate Ratio
 
The **duplicate ratio** of (a : b) is (a² : b²).</p
